reason_codes.schema-invalid: The record breaks the validity predicate (evidence kind, outcome, and bounds disagree).
reason_codes.outcome-counterexample: The verifier or test found a counterexample.
reason_codes.outcome-resource-exhausted: A time, memory, or solver resource limit was reached.
reason_codes.outcome-unsupported: The tool does not support a construct the claim depends on.
reason_codes.outcome-skipped: The harness or test was skipped.
reason_codes.outcome-tool-error: The tool failed before reaching a verdict.
reason_codes.witness-some-unsatisfied: A declared success witness (for example a Kani cover) was not reached.
reason_codes.control-some-rejected-otherwise: A negative control failed, but for a reason other than the intended one.
reason_codes.control-some-accepted: A negative control that must fail was accepted.
reason_codes.control-required-missing: A required negative control did not run.
reason_codes.trust-uncovered: A trusted item (assume, admit, external_body, stub, and similar) is not covered by a declared assumption or exception.
reason_codes.trust-unaudited: The trusted items were not audited.
reason_codes.exception-expired: The cited exception passed its invalid_from date.
reason_codes.exception-not-yet-valid: The cited exception is not yet approved on the evaluation date.
reason_codes.exception-malformed: The cited exception is unknown or breaks D02.
reason_codes.binding-stale: The executable, specification, or source revision differs from the current binding.
reason_codes.binding-incomplete: The record lacks an executable, specification, or source identity.
reason_codes.run-focused: The run used a focused or partial profile.
reason_codes.verdict-self-reported: No registered log parser re-derived the verdict from a committed log (C-EP-10).
reason_codes.not-run: The record is planned only; nothing ran.
reason_codes.trust-without-exception: A trust declaration has no active exception.
reason_codes.exception-active: Informational: an active exception restricts the admission level.
